question: The educational team of a preschool class plans to strengthen the appreciation of diversity based on the following learning objective of the core Understanding the Sociocultural Environment: "Recognize significant events in their personal and family history, in various situations."  Which of the following strategies allows addressing the proposed learning objective?
answer_a: Hold presentations about each child's family, introducing its members
answer_b: Include in the home area utensils and containers of products that the children use in their daily lives
answer_c: Set up workstations where the children represent different activities they perform with their families
answer_d: Conduct a circle time where the children present the profession or occupation of a family member

question: According to the following objective: "Read simple plans of your environment, using reference points and categories of relative position," what activities are most appropriate to evaluate it in Year 2?
answer_a: Draw a plan of the classroom
answer_b: Interpret the symbols of a city plan
answer_c: Describe the location of places on a given map
answer_d: Determine the coordinates of given points on a grid

question: A teacher of 8th grade, at the end of a unit, will evaluate her students' ability to select information sources, considering their reliability. To do this, she is preparing a guideline and has formulated the following evaluation indicators: 1. They identify the author of the source. 2. They briefly describe the origin or context of the source. Which of the following indicators, relevant to the content and level of the students, allows completing this evaluation guideline?
answer_a: They identify the type of source
answer_b: They argue about the meaning of the source
answer_c: They recognize the intentionality of the source
answer_d: They evaluate the validity of the data from the source
